description: Header file defining the interface for tree object management in a version control system, including functions for parsing, comparing, and reading tree objects.

methods.name: lookup_tree
methods.description: Lookup a tree object in the repository by object ID.

methods.name: parse_tree_buffer
methods.description: Parse a buffer into a tree object.

methods.name: parse_tree_gently
methods.description: Parse a tree object with an option to suppress errors.

methods.name: int parse_tree(struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Inline function that calls parse_tree_gently with quiet_on_missing=0.

methods.name: free_tree_buffer
methods.description: Free resources associated with a tree buffer.

methods.name: parse_tree_indirect
methods.description: Parse a tree object indirectly, following tags and commits.

methods.name: base_name_compare
methods.description: Compare two pathnames based on their base names.

methods.name: df_name_compare
methods.description: Compare two pathnames using a specific comparison method.

methods.name: read_tree_at
methods.description: Read a tree at a specific path and depth, applying a callback.

methods.name: read_tree
methods.description: Read a tree, given a pathspec and callback.

ctags.name: read_tree_fn_t
ctags.pattern: /^typedef int (*read_tree_fn_t)(const struct object_id *, struct strbuf *, const char *, unsigned /
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const struct object_id *,struct strbuf *,const char *,unsigned int,void *)
